chapterInfo.content:
12
Miriam ne Aaron kasa tia Mose
1 # Eks 2.21 Na Miriam ne Aaron kasa tiaa Mose sɛ ɔwaree Kusni baa, ɛfiri sɛ na waware Kusni baa bi. 2Na wɔkaa sɛ: Mose nko so na AWURADE nam kasa, na ɔmfa yɛn so nso nkasa a? Na AWURADE tee. 3Na ɔbarima Mose deɛ, na ɔdwo pii sene nnipa a wɔwɔ asase soɔ nyinaa. 4Ɛnna AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron ne Miriam mpofirim sɛ: Mo baasa momfiri adi mmra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ho. 5#Eks 16.10 Na wɔn baasa no firii adi. Na AWURADE sianee mununkum dum mu bɛgyinaa ntomadan no ano, na ɔfrɛɛ Aaron ne Miriam; na wɔn baanu firii adi. 6Na ɔkaa sɛ: Montie me nsɛm ɛ. Sɛ AWURADE diyifoɔ bi wɔ mo mu a, adehunu mu na mema no hu me, daeɛ mu na mekasa mekyerɛ no: 7#Heb 3.2 Na ɛnte sɛ m’akoa Mose; ɔno na mede me fie nyinaa ahyɛ ne nsa. 8#Eks 33.11, 23 Ano ne ano na me ne no de kasa ehunu mu, na ɛnyɛ mmebuo mu, na ɔhunu AWURADE suban. Na adɛn nti na moansuro sɛ mobɛkasa atia m’akoa Mose? 9Na AWURADE bo fuu wɔn, na ɔsii mu kɔe.
10 # Deut 24.9 Na mununkum no firii ntomadan no soɔ, na hwɛ, Miriam ayare kwata sɛ sukyerɛmma. Na Aaron danee ne ho hwɛɛ Miriam no, hwɛ, na wayare kwata. 11Na Aaron ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Wo kyɛw nie, me wura. Mfa bɔne a yɛadi nkwaseasɛm ayɛ yi nto yɛn so. 12Mma no nnyɛ sɛ efunu a ɔfiri ne na yam baeɛ na ne honam fa asɛe dada. 13#Eks 15.26 Na Mose su frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: O Onyankopɔn ee, mesrɛ wo, sa no yadeɛ ɛ! 14#Lew 13.46 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Na sɛ n’agya hinam n’ani so ntasuo kɛkɛ mpo a, anka n’ani renwu nnanson anaa? Wɔnto no mu nnanson nsraban no akyi, na ɛno akyiri ansa na wɔmfa no mmra mu bio. 15Na wɔtoo Miriam mu nsraban no akyi nnanson. Na ɔman no antu kɔsii sɛ wɔde Miriam baa mu bio. 16Na ɛno akyiri no, ɔman no tu firii Haserot, na wɔkɔkyeree nsraban Paran serɛ so.

Na Miriam ne Aaron kasa tiaa Mose sɛ ɔwaree Kusni baa, ɛfiri sɛ na waware Kusni baa bi. Na wɔkaa sɛ: Mose nko so na AWURADE nam kasa, na ɔmfa yɛn so nso nkasa a? Na AWURADE tee. Na ɔbarima Mose deɛ, na ɔdwo pii sene nnipa a wɔwɔ asase soɔ nyinaa. Ɛnna AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron ne Miriam mpofirim sɛ: Mo baasa momfiri adi mmra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ho. Na wɔn baasa no firii adi. Na AWURADE sianee mununkum dum mu bɛgyinaa ntomadan no ano, na ɔfrɛɛ Aaron ne Miriam; na wɔn baanu firii adi. Na ɔkaa sɛ: Montie me nsɛm ɛ. Sɛ AWURADE diyifoɔ bi wɔ mo mu a, adehunu mu na mema no hu me, daeɛ mu na mekasa mekyerɛ no: Na ɛnte sɛ m’akoa Mose; ɔno na mede me fie nyinaa ahyɛ ne nsa. Ano ne ano na me ne no de kasa ehunu mu, na ɛnyɛ mmebuo mu, na ɔhunu AWURADE suban. Na adɛn nti na moansuro sɛ mobɛkasa atia m’akoa Mose? Na AWURADE bo fuu wɔn, na ɔsii mu kɔe.
Na mununkum no firii ntomadan no soɔ, na hwɛ, Miriam ayare kwata sɛ sukyerɛmma. Na Aaron danee ne ho hwɛɛ Miriam no, hwɛ, na wayare kwata. Na Aaron ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Wo kyɛw nie, me wura. Mfa bɔne a yɛadi nkwaseasɛm ayɛ yi nto yɛn so. Mma no nnyɛ sɛ efunu a ɔfiri ne na yam baeɛ na ne honam fa asɛe dada. Na Mose su frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: O Onyankopɔn ee, mesrɛ wo, sa no yadeɛ ɛ! Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Na sɛ n’agya hinam n’ani so ntasuo kɛkɛ mpo a, anka n’ani renwu nnanson anaa? Wɔnto no mu nnanson nsraban no akyi, na ɛno akyiri ansa na wɔmfa no mmra mu bio. Na wɔtoo Miriam mu nsraban no akyi nnanson. Na ɔman no antu kɔsii sɛ wɔde Miriam baa mu bio. Na ɛno akyiri no, ɔman no tu firii Haserot, na wɔkɔkyeree nsraban Paran serɛ so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
